title: Why funerals ended: lodges and insurance
summary: Pope thinks finances ended funerals; insurance put the lodges out of business and their picnic work ended.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Why did they stop doing funerals? Do you know why they stopped doing funerals?
No, I don't know just exactly. I think it was financial conditions. Financial? Yes, I think so.
But the lodges and the organizations still exist in Mobile, were they? No.

The insurance put those people out of business, most of them, you know. They couldn't comply with the laws, you know, the state laws and so on. So finally they'd given up. Now we used to, those organizations, I'm saying, they had quite a few in Mobile. And they used to give picnics, you understand, once or twice a year and accumulate a few hundred dollars, you know. And we used to pay those picnics for them. And after that was cut out, after the band broken up to understand, I gave myself, blamed myself in a way, you know, I gave it all up. And after that, no one was very much interested in the band, you see. And so, I gradually put the organizations out of business. Because they didn't get that stuff, that extra money.
